mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) above 2% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL YoY > 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4% signals a tightening labor market, which can lead to wage inflation and subsequently to tighter monetary policy, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE < 4%.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in housing starts (HOUST) signals increased demand for housing and economic expansion, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are negative in more than 40% of instances when HOUST increases.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in industrial production (INDPRO) signals a contraction in supply, which can lead to negative economic growth expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO decreases.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) combined with a decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals strong labor market conditions, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are negative in more than 40% of instances when PAYEMS increases and UNRATE decreases.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals an easing monetary policy, which can lead to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are negative in more than 40% of instances when FEDFUNDS decreases.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in real final sales (RSAFS) signals increased consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when RSAFS increases.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in industrial production (INDPRO) combined with an increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) signals stagflationary pressures, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are positive in more than 40% of instances when INDPRO decreases and CPIAUCSL increases.
